summary: Platform cross-tenant Users dashboard. A user with role 'platform' now sees users from every tenant on GET /tenant/{tenant_id}/users, with a Tenant column. 'owner' and 'admin' remain limited to their own tenant, and role 'user' is still refused. UserManagementService reuses Tenant::findAll() and User::allByTenant(), so no new model method and no unscoped User query exist. The app template views hide the Users links from role 'user'. codebase.md gains the 'Reuse Before You Add' principle. No schema or route changes. Full detail in CHANGELOG.md [2.2.0].
breaking_changes: UserManagementService::__construct() now requires a second argument, tenantModel (Frank\Models\Tenant). The framework's own container binding passes it. Only apps that construct the service themselves must add the argument.
ai_notes: The cross-tenant scope is decided in UserManagementService::getUserDashboard() from the authenticated user's role ('platform'), never from request input. It loops Tenant::findAll() and calls the tenant-scoped User::allByTenant() once per tenant.
The service result gains crossTenant (bool), and each user row gains tenantName. UserManagementController passes crossTenant to the view.

App template changes (app/Views/users/management-dashboard.php, app/Views/partials/app-nav.php, app/Views/partials/app-header.php) are not in the release zip. Versions/FrankPHP_v2.2.0_upgrade_notes.md has the snippets to copy.
The UserManagementController access gate is unchanged: platform, admin and owner are allowed, and role user is redirected with ?error=forbidden.
